Its four nominated branches are each landed: the two focus branches use exact focus carriers, while the strength and opening branches use supplied context carriers and remain contextual resonances.

The supplied HFT trace connects the focus party to exact pericope carriers for displaced norm, equitable judgment, tested difference, and good-directed competition. Every branch is retained, with unresolved registry entries carried as attributed evidence rather than supplied glosses.

The supplied HFT trace gives repeated turning, denied assent, chosen alliance, and the focus party as a connected before-and-after relation. All six candidate branches land through exact focus or context occurrences; unresolved entries remain attributed.

The pericope trace supplies fear-driven alliance, exposure, collapse, apostasy, replacement traits, and the focus victory predicate as a materially changed reading. All fifteen branch refs are retained, using exact packet glosses where present and attributed contextual treatment for unresolved entries.

The adjacent 5:55 and focus 5:56 repeat the same triad while the supplied practices embody the returned relation. The complete eight-branch trace is a distinct reciprocal mechanism and is retained with legacy qualification.

The outlier has exact carriers in the focus and adjacent pericope, independent seed and growth triggers, a changed material image, and an explicit exploratory boundary. Its four branches are retained, with unresolved contextual branches marked as attributed.

The outlier gives a bounded cadence model grounded in the focus party, succession, and the adjacent repeated practices. Every one of its seven branch refs lands through a supplied occurrence, and the exploratory containment is preserved.

findings.title: Affiliation gathers into prevailing capacity
findings.claim: As supportive affiliation gathers, حِزْبَ names a social body whose nearness becomes collective capacity, while غَالِبُونَ names that body's prevailing outcome.
findings.mechanism: The focus group and prevailing predicate contact the trusted channel's strength and opened-outcome images through the pericope's competing and supportive affiliations, changing a flat party label into an account of how gathered nearness can act together.
findings.reader_payoff: The gathered party becomes perceptible as a collective capacity whose nearness can act together.
findings.containment: The ordinary conditional remains intact: whoever aligns with Allah, His messenger, and the believers belongs to Allah's party, and that party prevails. The added relation concerns collective formation and outcome; it does not reduce prevailing to one political or military scene.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted, while two of its non-focus branch records are nominated contextual images rather than focus lexical entries.

findings.title: Cohesion is tested by fair norm-following

findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see party cohesion as a tested, fair practice across difference, with beneficial good giving its competition direction.
findings.containment: The focus still names Allah's party and its prevailing status. The contextual trace adds a normatively tested form of cohesion; it does not declare that all difference has collapsed or that the pericope alone exhausts party identity.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is strong but legacy-unbound; exact context Arabic and word coordinates are supplied, while the context branch records remain attributed where the registry is unresolved.

findings.title: Prevailing remains open to replacement
findings.claim: The promise of prevailing is attached to a reproducible alignment pattern rather than unconditionally to an incumbent group: defensive alliances collapse, while a replaceable people embody love, gentleness, strength, and freedom from blame-driven fear.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for believing, supportive allegiance, and prevailing meet the 5:52 carriers of illness, haste, circular fear, opening, and concealment; 5:53 supplies collapse; 5:54 supplies apostasy and the replacement people's traits. The contact changes the result from inherited possession to a pattern that can be reproduced and can replace its incumbent.
findings.reader_payoff: The prevailing promise becomes readable as a repeatable pattern rather than a guarantee attached to an incumbent.
findings.containment: The ordinary focus still names Allah's party as prevailing. The trace adds replaceability and the motive structure around that claim; it does not identify a historical replacement, make replacement the only subject of 5:54, or erase the direct social reading.

epistemic.reason: The supplied HFT trace is strong and all anchors lie in the declared pericope, but the reader identity is legacy-unbound and several branch entries have no independent registry record.

findings.title: Returned allegiance becomes a practiced circuit
findings.claim: The paired verses form reciprocal wilaya: received support is answered through worship, giving, humility, and returned allegiance, and that circulation constitutes the prevailing party.
findings.mechanism: The focus tawalli and party carriers meet the immediately preceding wali declaration and its embodied practices. The repeated triad and result particle turn one-sided authority into a circuit in which practices carry the human side of allegiance.
findings.reader_payoff: The repeated triad and its practices let the reader perceive allegiance as circulation between support received and support enacted.
findings.containment: The focus still names Allah, His messenger, and the believers as the objects of tawalli and names Allah's party as prevailing. The contextual circuit adds reciprocity and embodiment without making the prior verse a complete replacement for the focus.

epistemic.reason: The trace has exact 5:55 and 5:56 carriers and a strong immediate connection, but its reader identity is legacy-unbound and split mappings remain attributed.

findings.title: Prevailing as cultivated interdependence
findings.claim: Exploratorily, reciprocal love is seed, repeated alignment is following rain, zakah is growth, and the party prevails by thickening into resilient interdependence.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for following alignment and prevailing density meet the adjacent 5:54 love and 5:55 growth carriers. The form-distant contact turns a social result into a material cultivation image.
findings.reader_payoff: A social victory can be pictured, exploratorily, as resilience that grows through repeated, nourishing alignment.
findings.containment: The ordinary social party and prevailing reading remains recoverable. This is an exploratory analogy assembled from the supplied focus branches and adjacent context; it does not claim that the focus words directly denote rain, seed, or vegetation.

epistemic.reason: The outlier explicitly marks itself exploratory; its focus branches have supplied registry records, while the adjacent seed and growth branches remain attributed.

findings.title: Party formation as cadence
findings.claim: Exploratorily, حِزْبَ also opens a cadence model: apportioned practices are repeatedly enacted and relayed until they form a durable social body.
findings.mechanism: The focus portion and succession carriers meet the immediately preceding prayer, giving, humility, and resolute rising. The repeated acts supply a rhythm, while the focus party supplies the collective body that the rhythm forms.
findings.reader_payoff: Party formation can be felt, exploratorily, as cadence: repeated practices make a durable body.
findings.containment: The ordinary focus still names a divine party that prevails. The cadence image adds a bounded model of formation; it does not say that حِزْبَ simply means ritual regimen or that every party has the same practice pattern.

epistemic.reason: The outlier is explicitly exploratory, with exact focus branch records for the portion, succession, and relayed groups; the remaining contextual branches are attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied carrier is attributed in the HFT trace as follows: Repeated giving makes the regimen socially circulatory rather than privately devotional.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus returns at 5:56:2:1, 5:56:4:2, 5:56:8:1 provide the independent contact for this contextual carrier.
branch_activations.activation: Repeated giving makes the regimen socially circulatory rather than privately devotional. The carrier meets the independent trigger through the focus return, so the focus reading is qualified by this relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Exploratorily, it is also a cadence: apportioned practices repeatedly enacted and relayed until they form a durable social body.
branch_activations.boundary: This is surprising because it activates the recurring-portion branch of حِزْب beside its ordinary social-group branch. It remains validly anchored in the focus noun and is sharpened by the immediately adjacent maintained prayer, giving, and bowing. Downstream prose should qualify it as a cadence model of party formation, not claim that حِزْب simply means ritual regimen here.
